components.name: Resume Sheet
components.description: Paper preview with the leaf-green hard offset shadow.

narrative.overview: BetterLeaf looks like a proof sheet on a printer's desk: deep spruce ink, chalk-white stock, hard-edged paper that casts a hard offset shadow, and one warm marker (sun) used only where the AI touched the text. The visual rule mirrors the product rule: the AI selects and orders, it does not invent, so every change must be visibly marked and nothing decorative competes with the resume itself.
keyCharacteristics: Spruce ink for text, chrome and the code window; chalk for pages; white only for paper.
1.5px ink borders and hard offset shadows instead of blurs.
Pill buttons; 18px cards; the PDF sheet is the only element that reads as "paper".
Sun yellow means "changed by the AI", nothing else.
Display type is heavy and tight (800, -0.025em); body is quiet humanist sans.

rules.name: The Sun Means Changed Rule
rules.body: Sun yellow appears only on content the AI modified (plus the caret and the "2 pages" warning pill). Using it as decoration destroys its meaning.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Leaf green is the only chromatic accent; no blue, purple, or gradients.

rules.name: The Tight Heavy Display Rule
rules.body: Display type is always 700-800 with negative tracking; never light, never loosely tracked.

rules.name: The No Blur Rule
rules.body: Shadows are hard offset blocks, never soft or diffused, and appear only on paper-like surfaces.

dos: Do use spruce (#10281f) for text, borders and primary fills; chalk (#f2f4f0) for pages.
Do reserve sun (#f2c14e) for AI-changed content and the caret.
Do use hard offset shadows (8-10px, zero blur) on paper-like focal surfaces only.
Do keep buttons pill-shaped with a leaf-green hover.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`; motion is a single 0.5-0.7s settle (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)) on load.
Do treat the namespaced `.bl` / `.bl-ws` spruce tokens as the source of truth for new UI; migrate the shadcn neutral defaults toward them.
donts: Don't introduce blur shadows, glassmorphism, or gradients.
Don't add a second chromatic accent beside leaf green.
Don't ship new UI with the default shadcn neutral greys and 0.625rem radius; it contradicts the spruce identity.
Don't use modals for core tailoring flow; PRODUCT.md requires inline, single-page interaction.
